title: Nautical Retextures
description: A little pack that changes the textures of almost all aquatic and semi aquatic mobs in the game with a "Fresh" and "Realistic" take on the seas
body:
A resource pack that changes textures of some water mobs including Squid, Glow Squid,Guardian ,Elder Guardian, Dolphin, Turtle, all Axolotl variants, Cod, Salmon, Nautilus, and Pufferfish 
although just being lazy retextures I still wanted to post this silly little thing that adds a "realistic"and"Fresh" take on aquatic mobs so use it how you like just dont blatantly repost it anywhere hope u enjoy lol
